reviews.text: Kirby is a master. Exactly what I needed, great cut, and the whole experience was seamless. Already booked my next appointment!
Sarah Schnabel is a great hair stylist! She always does an amazing job with my cut and color. I highly recommend her!

Michelle has been doing my extensions for three years now and they look amazing every. single. time. She blends them flawlessly and gives me a super blended beautiful blonde. I always look forward to being in her chair!! Highly recommended.
